title: CyberRAG: An Agentic RAG cyber attack classification and reporting tool
authors: Francesco Blefari; Cristian Cosentino; Francesco Aurelio Pironti; Angelo Furfaro; Fabrizio Marozzo
why_relevant: Applies agentic RAG with iterative retrieval to cyber-attack classification; mentions robustness to adversarial payloads but does not study RAG robustness systematically.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain application paper; robustness claims are limited to attack-classification accuracy, not RAG-specific noise/conflict/poisoning analysis.
